_comment: Structured output (the score) of the audit skill. Written next to bundle.json; money_leak_report.py merges it into the single client-ready AUDIT.html. Generic example below.
headline: Solid foundation; the biggest gains are in conversion-tracking verification and search-term hygiene.

fixable.title: Conversion value tracking is static
fixable.fix: Send dynamic order values from the store instead of a flat value.

fixable.title: Thin negative keyword coverage
fixable.fix: Add a shared negative list (DIY, job-seeker, location) from the search-terms report.

fixable.title: $1,180/mo on non-converting terms
fixable.fix: Negate the 12 terms with >$10 spend and 0 conversions.

fixable.title: Two ad groups have only 1 RSA
fixable.fix: Add a second RSA to each so Google can test variants.

fixable.title: Avg Quality Score 6.4
fixable.fix: Tighten ad-group themes for the 5 lowest-QS keywords.

fixable.title: PMax brand exclusion not applied
fixable.fix: Apply a brand exclusion list so PMax stops claiming brand conversions.

fixable.title: Location set to Presence or Interest
fixable.fix: Switch to 'Presence' to stop out-of-market spend.

notes: Google Ads vs GA4 ROAS gap is 28% — normal methodology difference, not a tracking bug.
Conversion setup is healthy: the channel Purchase is the working primary; GA4 purchase is correctly secondary.
